Are you preparing for AAI JE & Manager 2026 Document Verification (DV)? In this video, we discuss the List of DV Rejection Reasons in AAI JE & Manager 2026, important document-related mistakes, eligibility issues, and other possible reasons that candidates should be aware of before their Document Verification.

If you have appeared for the AAI Junior Executive 2026 or AAI Manager 2026 CBT Examination, this video is especially important for you. We will discuss common mistakes related to educational qualification certificates, degree certificates, marksheets, category certificates (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS), PwBD certificates (where applicable), name mismatch in documents, date of birth discrepancies, incomplete documents, and other verification-related issues that may create problems during the DV process.
